svg.title: Vicsek order parameter against heading noise
svg.desc: Order parameter against heading noise for the 1995 Vicsek rule and for the Coop yard rule, and the noise a given CPU pressure produces in the coop.
svg.text: Order against noise: the 1995 rule and the Coop yard
phi = |sum of velocities| / sum of speeds; each point is a time average after a burn-in (1000 steps, the last 500 for the periodic box; 1200 steps, the last 300 for the yard)
Coop yard rule (N = 60, r = 4, 0.6 u/s, fence)
Panel C reads panel A through panel B: it interpolates the orange mean at eta(psi, CV). Orange dots in A are the six seeds, each a time average over the last 15 s.
